title: 176. Baseball Game

examples.explanation: "5" - Add 5 to the record, record is now [5]. "2" - Add 2 to the record, record is now [5, 2]. "C" - Invalidate and remove the previous score, record is now [5]. "D" - Add 2 * 5 = 10 to the record, record is now [5, 10]. "+" - Add 5 + 10 = 15 to the record, record is now [5, 10, 15]. The sum is 30.

"5" - Add 5, record is [5]. "-2" - Add -2, record is [5, -2]. "4" - Add 4, record is [5, -2, 4]. "C" - Remove 4, record is [5, -2]. "D" - Add 2 * -2 = -4, record is [5, -2, -4]. "9" - Add 9, record is [5, -2, -4, 9]. "+" - Add -4 + 9 = 5, record is [5, -2, -4, 9, 5]. "+" - Add 9 + 5 = 14, record is [5, -2, -4, 9, 5, 14]. The sum is 27.
"1" - Add 1 to the record, record is now [1]. "C" - Invalidate and remove the previous score, record is now []. The sum is 0.

hints: Keep a stack (list) of valid scores and update it for each operation.
For '+' push the sum of the last two scores; for 'D' push twice the last score; for 'C' pop the last score; otherwise parse and push the integer.
